name: design-audit
description: Replaces vague 'looks good' UI feedback with a fixed, repeatable audit: walks a design system, UI, or app screen against 13 categories of proven UI/UX practice — iconography, color, typography, hierarchy, spacing, states, shadows, dark mode, overlays, and page patterns — and returns a severity-scored findings report with a concrete fix for each issue. Specifically flags AI/vibe-coded tells (emoji icons, clashing default palettes, duplicated modules, dead cards) since they're high-value, low-effort fixes.
